rationale: A recovery-specific monetary ceiling is a durable safety boundary for retries and replacement executions. Nesting already establishes its scope, so the short established monetary name is unambiguous.
alternatives: Remove if recovery actions never incur separately controllable provider spend.
Rename to recovery_spend_cap_microusd only if this field moves out of recovery_policy.
simplestChoice: Keep an optional integer spend_cap_microusd under recovery_policy.
